_meta.rule: A field is populated only if it was read in this session from the official listing (I2-S07…I2-S13). Anything not read stays null and is rendered as 'Not published'. No value is carried over from another session's capture, because those captures are dated observations that Program Policies 2(b) and 6(t) do not allow this site to display.
_meta.identity_caveat: The three links were supplied as nine-character link.amazon short-link tokens. Each was followed and opened a live listing. Nothing official establishes that the listing is the product the owner meant to promote, so identity is recorded as an observation and the question is published as Q2 in the decision board.
_meta.tag_caveat: The observed redirects carry no Associates tag. Program Policies 2(b) require the tag parameter on every link to an Amazon Site, so this site publishes no tagged buy link yet and every 'buy' action is disabled and labelled. The link that IS shown is labelled an evidence link and earns nothing.
